status: Static concepts for discussion, not product screenshots or engine implementation
recommendation: B2 for actual forks and AND joins

images.title: Fixed compact cards
images.description: Fixed width with name and duration. Show owners in team headings and details; long time windows do not stretch the cards.

images.title: Text with thin time bars
images.description: Keep labels separate from thin time bars while preserving the time span. Workday counts do not equal calendar-window lengths.

images.title: Collapsible task groups
images.description: Group consecutive task chains within each team. Lines between groups summarize connections; expand to verify task dependencies. The calendar is not drawn to scale.

images.title: Direct connections between nearby ports
images.description: Connect nearby vertical nodes bottom-to-top and nearby horizontal nodes directly, instead of always routing right-to-left.

images.title: Shared channels for branches and joins
images.description: Branches from one source and AND joins at one target share segments, with explicit junctions that preserve each actual dependency.

images.title: Focus selected node
images.description: Selecting an approval node emphasizes both required incoming dependencies and keeps other lines in the background. This reading aid does not replace obstacle routing.

A2Revision.reason: Time-axis T0 moved to the far right to avoid implying the approval task is scheduled after the event; graphical positions remain illustrative.
